title: Hourly Auto-Dig: dark-academia / ECFR Berlin office
summary: Dataset-first randomized Auto-Dig pass for dark-academia, selecting ECFR and adding source-bounded Berlin office geography without asserting an unsupported headquarters label.

sources.title: Contact us – European Council on Foreign Relations
Imprint – European Council on Foreign Relations
General privacy notice – European Council on Foreign Relations

data.research_question: What defensible public organizational location can be added to ECFR without conflating office/legal registration with headquarters, and has current news materially changed the dark-academia/ECFR evidence graph?
data.method: Global dataset/topic enumeration; deterministic seeded two-stage selection with recent-run and geography exclusions; repository search; first-party ECFR contact/imprint/privacy review; current-news search; typed-document enrichment; recursive-target creation.
classification_rules: Dataset stage is approximately uniform over the full eligible dataset/topic pool after diversity exclusions.
Previous three successful hourly datasets were excluded: drunk-drivers, greater-israel, cia.
Previous-three dominant geographies Utah, Israel, and California were avoided when alternatives existed.
Location roles are preserved exactly: Berlin is an office and ECFR e.V. legal-entity address, not promoted to headquarters without explicit source wording.
Current-news results are ingested only when they add material entity, event, relation, correction, conflict, or location evidence.

findings.selection_algorithm: sorted full pool -> remove previous-three datasets -> random.Random(seed).choice; continue same RNG for stage-two target choice

findings.result: ECFR's first-party contact page identifies Unter den Linden 17, 10117 Berlin as its Berlin office; its imprint identifies ECFR e.V. at the same address. A separate privacy notice distinguishes the London registered office. The Berlin record is therefore typed as office, not headquarters.

findings.scope: Current web/news search through 2026-08-19 for European Council on Foreign Relations / ECFR, including first-party ECFR pages and recent independent reporting.
findings.result: No material new organizational, relationship, or location event was found that justified a new StarIntel news record. Recent reporting mainly relayed ECFR policy analysis or commentary, so no filler news document was ingested.

gaps: Explicit ECFR global-headquarters wording remains unresolved.

provenance.method: hourly Auto-Dig HQ/location and current-news enrichment
